items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: Fred Fisher's sensation. You're the only girl that made me cry.

ctx.x: A rare blossom from the garden of hits. Hit number two. Fred Fisher's sensation. You're the only girl that made me cry. No wonder they, quote, cry, unquote, for more. Try it and you'll, quote, cry, unquote, yet.
